title: Tests: what to prepare for
lead: Italian universities ask for different tests. This page shows which test is for what, how it is taken and which universities ask for it.

tests.how: Taken at official centres in Uzbekistan. Some universities require the certificate to be no older than 2–3 years.
tests.cost: Check the price on the official organisation's website
tests.unis: For example: Parma (IELTS 5.5+, TOEFL 69+), Teramo (IELTS 5.5, TOEFL 72), Milan (B2, not older than 3 years)

tests.for: English-taught bachelor's: engineering, economics, pharmacy and other subjects
tests.how: From home (CEnT@CASA) or at a university (CEnT@UNI). 5 periods for 2027/28: Nov–Jan, Feb–Mar, Apr–May, Jun–Jul, Aug–Sep. Dates are set by universities.
tests.unis: For example: Padova, Bologna (English-taught bachelor's programmes)

tests.how: Can also be taken from home (TOLC@CASA), even if you are not in Italy. Note: the English versions of TOLC were replaced by CEnT-S from November 2025.
tests.unis: For example: Pavia (not selective, in some programmes)

tests.for: Some international bachelor's programmes (more often at private universities)
tests.how: Through the College Board, at international test centres.
tests.cost: Check the price on the College Board website
tests.unis: For example: Bocconi (its own test or SAT)

tests.how: At a test centre or online.
tests.cost: Check the price on the official website
tests.unis: For example: Bocconi (GMAT/GRE or its own online test), LUISS master's

tests.name: The university's own test
tests.how: Usually online; you register together with the application.
tests.unis: For example: Bocconi test, LUISS test, San Raffaele and UniCamillus medicine tests (180–200 €)

tests.name: Italian language tests
tests.how: A certificate or a university/CISIA test (online).
tests.cost: For example: CISIA Italian test 35 € (Pavia, at least 54/72), Brescia test 25 €
tests.unis: For example: Pavia, Verona (CISIA ITA-L2), Brescia, Cattolica (B2 Italian for bachelor's)

tips: First read the «Admission and requirements» section of your chosen university: that is where it says which test you need.
Take IELTS before applications open: many applications are not accepted without a certificate.
CEnT-S and TOLC can be taken from home, but check which format the university accepts.
The test date must be before the application deadline: leave time for the result to arrive.
